title: 横浜スタジアム女子観戦1日Vlog〜推し活グルメ&乾杯編
scene: 友達同士で横浜スタジアムに到着し、笑顔で入場ゲートを通過。売店で人気の球場グルメやドリンクを選びワクワク。スタンドの席に並んで座り、乾杯しながら盛り上がり、そのまま応援が始まる。
caption: 野球女子の“球場観戦”って、何回行ってもワクワクが止まらないよね！🌈 今日は推し活仲間と横浜スタジアムで1日満喫してきたよ。ゲートをくぐった瞬間、グルメの香りと応援の音でテンションMAX！売店で迷いながら選んだ名物グルメを手に、スタンドで乾杯🍻 そして推しの応援が始まれば、隣に仲間がいる幸せを実感…✨ 実は、前は「一緒に観てくれる友達いないな…」って不安だったけど、Draftで観戦仲間ができて、こんなに楽しくなるなんて！推し活・グルメ・おしゃべり全部楽しんじゃう、これが“野球女子のとっておきの休日”だよね⚾️ みんなはどんな球場体験が好き？あなたはどれに共感しましたか？

prompts.kling: A group of 2-3 Japanese women in their 20s, smiling and chatting, walk through the entrance gate of Yokohama Stadium with casual, trendy outfits. The camera follows their natural movements as they stop by a bustling concession stand, laugh while choosing popular stadium food and drinks, then head up the stadium steps to their seats. They sit down, clink drinks in a cheerful toast, and start cheering, blending into the lively atmosphere of the baseball crowd. All scenes are in vertical 9:16 format, with realistic smartphone-shot, handheld camera, lively but natural motion, photorealistic look, and no text overlays or AI artifacts.
prompts.veo: 0-5s: Two to three Japanese women in their 20s arrive together at the entrance of Yokohama Stadium, waving tickets and smiling as they pass through the gate. 5-10s: The women stand in line and browse a concession stand, giggling as they point at and select popular stadium food and cold drinks. 10-15s: Seated side-by-side in the stadium stands, the friends hold up snacks and drinks for a joyful toast, then join the crowd in lively baseball cheering, capturing the excitement of the game. Camera is vertical 9:16, photorealistic, handheld smartphone style, no overlays or AI artifacts.
